title: BatchEnsemble-style rank-one Mirror experts

model.router: one shared trained linear softmax gate, held constant across expert methods

task.expert_maps: shared random base plus one shared rank-one functional direction with expert coefficient

hypothesis: A rank-one Mirror coordinate bank on a shared expert can preserve routed task quality at fewer bytes than independent MoE experts; compare native BatchEnsemble rank-one modulation and an unconstrained generic shared rank-one coefficient control.
mirror_coordinate: per-expert bounded scalar m decoded as 1.5*tanh(m) over one shared rank-one direction
controls: standard top-1 MoE with four untied experts
generic unbounded shared rank-one coefficient control with same basis and per-expert codes

development.allowed: fixed 500 Adam updates at lr 0.01; check task/routing/serializer only, no fresh access

storage.authority: actual torch-serialized inference payload bytes including shared router, expert weights, codes/factors and metadata

success_gate: Mirror mean routed NRMSE within 0.01 of standard MoE and uses <=50% of its serialized bytes in every fresh world; compare against BatchEnsemble and generic coefficient control for any Mirror-specific claim.
failure_gate: Mirror loses >0.05 NRMSE vs standard MoE or does not improve storage at matched quality; generic coefficient control matching Mirror precludes a Mirror-specific claim.
boundaries: Synthetic regression only; no natural-language or large MoE claim.
Router is shared and supplied as the same trained state across methods to isolate expert storage.
Task experts are deliberately rank-one aligned, so the random-task limitation remains open.

amendment_before_fresh.reason: Small matrix payloads are sensitive to per-tensor container headers, so comparing raw nested torch.save dictionaries would conflate representation with Python serialization overhead.
amendment_before_fresh.change: Serialize every method as one flat expert tensor and one flat router tensor plus the same shape/key metadata; decode by deterministic reshape.

development_summary.interpretation: Mirror and generic rank-one control are functionally and byte-identical; standard MoE has better routed quality at same bytes.
